item.title: Nearly €24 million announced for Cavan/Monaghan healthcare
item.description: An announcement of nearly €24 million to be invested in healthcare in Cavan/ Monaghan area has been welcomed locally. The Minister for Health, Jennifer Carroll MacNeill, has today approved the publication of the Health Service Executive's Building and Equipment Capital Plan for 2026. item.title: Monaghan director nominated for award at Dublin Film Festival
item.description: A Co Monaghan woman has been nominated for a Discovery Award by the Irish Film Industry at this year's Dublin Film Festival. Local director Taine King has been nominated for her work on the short film - Molly and the Robot. The Dublin International Film Festival Discovery Awards are a key Irish film industry accolade for emerging talent, covering directing, writing, performance, and cinematography. item.title: Co Cavan woman stranded in New York following snow blizzard
item.description: A powerful blizzard dropped more than 30cms of snow across parts yesterday bringing travel to a near standstill for millions. A Co Cavan woman who was due to return home from New York had her flight cancelled following treacherous conditions. Anne Conney's flight was one of some 5,700 flights shelved due to the amount of snow that fell across the US. The Co Cavan woman is hoping she can board a flight from New York this evening. Advertisement People in New York were urged to stay home yesterday.

item.title: Castleblayney business forced to close due to rising costs
item.description: A small, family-run business in Castleblayney has decided to shut its door due to rising costs. The Hidden Village Role Play Centre in Castleblayney opened 18 months ago, offering a unique role play centre where children can explore, imagine, and learn through play. In August proprietor Aoife Watters decided to make the difficult decision and close the doors but due to the volume of support she decided not to close. item.title: Ukrainian and Irish community to stand together in Cavan
item.description: Today in Cavan a solemn event is planned to mark the fourth anniversary of the invasion of Ukraine by Russia. The commemoration will take place today, from 17:00 to 19:00, in the Central Library, Cavan. The Association of Ukrainians in the Republic of Ireland - or AURI - has organised the gathering to honour the resilience and courage of the Ukrainian people, remember those who have suffered and sacrificed, and reaffirm our collective commitment to justice and peace.
